div.div: أَفْسَأُ i. q. أَبْزَخُ [i. e. Having a protuberant breast, or chest, and hollow back; &c.]: or having a protuberant breast, or chest, and the lower part of the belly prominent: (M, K:) fem. فَسَآءُ: (M:) and (M, in the K “ or ”) he who, when he walks, is as though his posteriors were in pain (in the M تَوْجَعُ; in some copies of the K تَوَجَّعُ [as though for تَتَوَجَّعُ], and in some يرجع); as also ↓ مَفْسُوْءٌ : (M, K:) or he who, when he sits, cannot rise but with an effort: (O, K:) or whose spine enters into [or turns inwards between] his haunches. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
